hints.title: Prefix Buildability Sequential Construction
hints.text: A word can only be built one character at a time if every prefix of length 1, 2, up to len - 1 is also a valid word in the dictionary.

hints.title: Immediate Prefix Presence Invariant
hints.text: If words are sorted lexicographically, then whenever word[:-1] is already recognized as buildable, word itself becomes buildable.

hints.title: Set Filtered Lexicographical Scan Procedure
hints.text: Sort the word list lexicographically. Maintain a set of buildable words initialized with the empty string. For each word, check if word[:-1] exists in the buildable set. If present, add word to the set, and if its length strictly exceeds the current longest word length, update the champion word. Return the longest word found.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input length or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N * log N + N * L) time and O(N * L) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Verifying all prefix combinations repeatedly without sorting or hashing requires quadratic prefix lookups.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting takes O(N * log N * L) and single-pass hash set insertion runs in O(N * L) time with O(N * L) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that sorting lexicographically ensures shorter words and alphabetically smaller ties are evaluated in the correct sequence.
